    Rows and columns of the mesh derivative #

    Subsection 5.1 of the manuscript (mesh-deformations.tex).

    For a scalar mesh category C = C(Q, c) the derivative D_m of eq:mesh-derivative is linear. Its target V_{m+1} is spanned by the rows (x, w): a nonprojective vertex x and a path w : τ x → x of length m + 1, placed in the x-th component. A correction column is an arrow b together with a parallel path p; by eq:mesh-derivative its image has at most two entries (column_eq). This file sets up these objects:

    • meshDerivativeₗ, the derivative as a linear map;
    • imageD c m, the image of the degree-m families;
    • row c x w, the row of a path, and surjective_iff_rows: D_m is surjective exactly when every row of length m + 1 lies in the image;
    • column_eq, the two entries of a correction column.

              theorem MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.ScalarMeshCategory.column_eq {k : Type u} [CommRing k] {V : Type v} [Quiver V] {Q : TranslationQuiver V} [(x : V) → Fintype ((y : V) × (y ⟶ x))] (c : MeshCoefficients k Q) [DecidableEq V] [(x y : V) → DecidableEq (x ⟶ y)] [DecidablePred fun (x : V) => x ∈ Q.nonprojective] (x : ↑Q.nonprojective) {y : V} (a : y ⟶ ↑x) (p : Quiver.Path (↑(Q.tau x)) y) :
              meshDerivative c (Pi.single ⟨↑(Q.tau x), ⟨y, (Q.mate x y) a⟩⟩ (pathMor c p)) = ↑(c x y a) • row c x (p.cons a) + if hy : y ∈ Q.nonprojective then ↑(c ⟨y, hy⟩ (↑(Q.tau x)) ((Q.mate x y) a)) • row c ⟨y, hy⟩ (((Q.mate ⟨y, hy⟩ ↑(Q.tau x)) ((Q.mate x y) a)).toPath.comp p) else 0

              A correction column has at most two entries (proof of prop:periodic-localization). Correcting the arrow σ a : τ x → y (for a : y → x) by a parallel path p contributes c_{x,a} p a to the mesh at x and, if y is nonprojective, c_{y,σ a} (σ σ a) p to the mesh at y.
